Cat stem cell therapy gives humans hope

The technique involves taking a cat’s own fat-derived stem cells, processing and characterizing them, and then giving them back intravenously to reduce inflammation and promote tissue regeneration.

Wow, this is fascinating stuff. Looking forward to reading further studies on this.

This is actually the basic legal technique of treating humans in the US. Sometimes they use platelet rich plasma in conjunction with it. The doctor "liposuctions" some fat out, dissolves the tissue (using a lysate), centrifuges down the cells, then resuspends them and puts them in the IV. They can also directly inject the cells. I think the use of the IV may be questionable. Injection is definitely legal. It would not be legal in the US to expand (culture) the cells and reinfect them (even if they are your own). In other countries they can not only expand your own cells but they can give you donor cells (usually from umbilical chord or other donated birth tissue).
